caption: A gymnast performs a back handspring, landing cleanly on their feet on a padded floor.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A gymnast performs a back handspring, landing cleanly on their feet on a padded floor. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The gymnast must be positioned in a handstand with legs extended horizontally before initiating the back handspring.
The gymnast must push off the floor with their hands to begin the backward motion, transitioning into a tucked or tucked-like position mid-air.
The gymnast must rotate fully backward in the air and extend their body to prepare for landing.
The gymnast must land on both feet simultaneously with knees slightly bent to absorb impact, maintaining balance and control.
